title: Premature Heartbeat Detection
description: Screen a single-lead ECG beat as normal or premature beat with a CNN binary classifier.
long_description: Train a model in DEEPCRAFT™ Studio to screen single-lead ECG beats as normal or premature (PVC, R-on-T PVC, or supraventricular). It uses 140-sample beats from 15 PhysioNet BIDMC heart-failure recordings with automated labels. This is a screening demonstration, not a diagnostic device.
